say: Accountants, lawyers and clinics paste client notes into AI chat every day. RedactGate is a self-hosted gateway that lets a firm use Claude without sending Claude its clients.
caption: Accountants, lawyers and clinics paste client notes into AI chat every day. RedactGate is a self-hosted gateway that lets a firm use Claude without sending Claude its clients.

say: Staff sign in with Clerk. Each firm is a Clerk organization, and the member's role decides what they can do: admin, compliance officer, or member.
caption: Staff sign in with Clerk. Each firm is a Clerk organization, and the member's role decides what they can do: admin, compliance officer, or member.

say: Here is a synthetic tax file note with a social insurance number, a health card, a bank account and an address. One click seals every value and sends the note to Claude Opus five point five.
caption: Here is a synthetic tax file note with a social insurance number, a health card, a bank account and an address. One click seals every value and sends the note to Claude Opus 5.5.

say: On the left, what stayed inside the firm, each value tagged by type. In the middle, the exact text Claude received: placeholders only. On the right, Claude's answer, with the real values put back on our side of the line.
caption: On the left, what stayed inside the firm, each value tagged by type. In the middle, the exact text Claude received: placeholders only. On the right, Claude's answer, with the real values put back on our side of the line.

say: Each request writes one audit event, chained by hash: entity counts, tokens and latency. The note itself is never stored.
caption: Each request writes one audit event, chained by hash: entity counts, tokens and latency. The note itself is never stored.

say: A compliance officer signs in to the same firm. She sees the audit trail with the chain re-verified, and read-only policies. She cannot send prompts.
caption: A compliance officer signs in to the same firm. She sees the audit trail with the chain re-verified, and read-only policies. She cannot send prompts.

say: Clerk sign-in, firm roles, the playground and the Canadian detection fixes were built during Build North. RedactGate is open source. Try it at redactgate dot mmix dot biz.
caption: Clerk sign-in, firm roles, the playground and the Canadian detection fixes were built during Build North. RedactGate is open source. Try it at redactgate.mmix.biz.
